description: For complete native \(R\) and a supplied intuitionistic theory certificate of \(T\vdash A\), image its actual finite support \(\Gamma\subseteq T\) to \(\Gamma^{[R]}\subseteq T^{[R]}\) and apply the public translation to its actual proof field. This constructs a certificate of \(T^{[R]}\vdash F_R(A)\) with the same equality mode.
